question: Which of the following keyboard shortcuts is used in a Windows 10 system to switch between open apps?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alt + Tab.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A popular Windows shortcut key is **Alt + Tab**, which **allows you **to **switch between all of your open programs**.
 
• While continuing to hold down the **Alt key**, **choose the program **you want to **open by clicking Tab until the correct application is highlighted**, then **release both keys**.
 
• You can also **Select the Task View icon **on **the taskbar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ctrl+N **is a keyboard shortcut most often used to **create a new document**, **window**, **workbook**, or **another type of file**.
 
• **Ctrl+Tab **is a keyboard shortcut most often used to **switch between open tabs in a browser.**
 
• In **Microsoft PowerPoint**, the **Alt + N **keyboard shortcut opens the **Insert tab **in the **Ribbon**.
